what_is.heading: What Are R6 Credits and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: R6 Credits are the premium currency in Rainbow Six Siege X. You spend them on the seasonal Battle Pass, new operators and cosmetics like weapon skins, uniforms, headgear and charms.
Renown is the free currency you earn by playing. R6 Credits are the one you buy, and some items in the shop are sold only for Credits.

official_prices.heading: R6 Credits Prices: Official Store vs DropMarket
official_prices.note: These are Ubisoft Store prices in US dollars. Bigger packs give more Credits per dollar, and console stores can show different pack sizes.

delivery.heading: How R6 Credits Delivery Works
steps: Link an Xbox (Microsoft) account to your Ubisoft account. It's free, and you can create one at xbox.com if you don't have one.
After checkout, send the seller the login for that linked Xbox account in the order chat.
The seller tops up the Credits on that account.
Launch Siege, check your Credit balance, then confirm the order. Change your Xbox password afterwards.
delivery.typical_time: Sellers on DropMarket quote 15 to 30 minutes while they're online.

support_topic.heading: How Do You Link an Xbox Account to Ubisoft?
paragraphs: Sign in at account.ubisoft.com, open Linked accounts and choose Xbox. You'll be sent to Microsoft to sign in and approve the link.
Your operators, skins and progress sit on your Ubisoft account, so the Xbox account is just the route the seller uses to add Credits. Use a fresh Xbox account with no card saved on it.

faq_extra.q: How much is the R6 Battle Pass in Credits?
faq_extra.a: Check the in-game shop for the current season. Ubisoft sets the Battle Pass price in R6 Credits each season.

faq_extra.q: What's the difference between Renown and R6 Credits?
faq_extra.a: Renown is earned by playing and can't be bought. R6 Credits are bought with real money, and some items are Credit-only.

notes: Pack prices read from the Ubisoft US store HTML on 2026-10-05 (600/$4.99, 1,200/$9.99, 3,300/$24.99, 7,200/$49.99, 15,000/$99.99); older guides list 2,670/4,920/7,560/16,000 packs, which seem to be older or console-store sizes. Our config bundles 30,000 and 45,000 don't exist as official packs (stacked purchases). Delivery method taken from our live R6 listings: buyer links an Xbox account to Ubisoft and hands the seller that login; one seller even asks for Ubisoft login. So no_password is FALSE and the current config FAQ ('Never share your password') contradicts how our R6 sellers actually deliver. Sellers say Credits 'appear across all linked platforms'; I could not confirm Ubisoft's current rule on cross-platform Credit sharing (the help page is JS-rendered; third-party sources conflict), so it's left out. The Ubisoft account-linking steps are the usual flow but I didn't fetch a Ubisoft page that spells them out: medium confidence. The 'Change your Xbox password afterwards' advice is ours. Battle Pass Credit price not stated because I couldn't confirm the current season's price.
